rows.label: Slug
rows.guidance: Fixed by the redirect table. Not editable: a thousand encoded tags resolve through it.

rows.label: Blend name
rows.guidance: Supplied. The five names are in the Scope document, 'The five blends'.

rows.label: Tag code
rows.guidance: Fixed by the redirect table.

rows.label: Launch tier
rows.guidance: real for the two launch blends, seeded for the other three.

rows.label: Tagline
rows.guidance: One line under the blend name. Renders above the fold at 375 px, so 120 characters is the practical ceiling even though the contract allows 200.

rows.label: Origin country
rows.guidance: Two letter ISO 3166-1 code. One code only: a blend whose stated origin spans several countries cannot be expressed in this field and needs a decision.

rows.label: Origin region
rows.guidance: Province, state or named region as Trevean wants it printed.

rows.label: Origin city
rows.guidance: City or town. Omit rather than guess.

rows.label: Farm latitude
rows.guidance: Decimal degrees, 4 decimal places. Coarse enough not to identify a private address, per the API contract. Never invented: see the placeholder convention.

rows.label: Farm longitude
rows.guidance: Decimal degrees, 4 decimal places.

rows.label: Farm map label
rows.guidance: What the pin says. For example a district name, not a street address.

rows.label: Origin story
rows.guidance: One heading plus 2 to 5 paragraphs. Block types are heading, paragraph and quote only: no HTML. The first paragraph must read as a complete opening on its own, because the Acceptance criteria document section 6.3 requires the origin story visible without scrolling.

rows.label: Story block text
rows.guidance: Per paragraph. Heading blocks 20 to 60 characters.

rows.label: Hero photograph
rows.guidance: See the image specification. 1280 by 955, 90 KB after our processing, single subject, shallow depth of field.

rows.label: Gallery photographs
rows.guidance: Below the fold, lazy loaded, counts against the 600 KB whole page image budget. Send as many or as few as you like.

rows.label: Harvest date
rows.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD. A provenance claim: never invented, left null until supplied.

rows.label: Blend date
rows.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD.

rows.label: Best before
rows.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD. A food safety claim.

rows.label: Lot label
rows.guidance: Printed lot reference. Freshness is per blend, not per jar: tag encoding is per SKU so per lot attribution is impossible.

rows.label: Freshness note
rows.guidance: A statement about how the system works, not about the spice. Authored by us and correct as written.

rows.guidance: Structural link. The grower record behind it is a separate entity with its own fields.

rows.label: Recipe title
rows.guidance: Reads on one or two lines in a carousel card at 375 px.

rows.label: Recipe summary
rows.guidance: One or two sentences on the card.

rows.label: Servings
rows.guidance: Whole number.

rows.label: Prep minutes
rows.guidance: Whole minutes.

rows.label: Cook minutes
rows.guidance: Whole minutes.

rows.label: Difficulty
rows.guidance: One of easy, medium, hard.

rows.label: Ingredients
rows.guidance: Each line is quantity, unit, item and an optional note, supplied as four separate values rather than one string, so the page can format them and a future translation does not have to parse English.

rows.label: Method steps
rows.guidance: One step per entry, up to 800 characters each. No numbering in the text: the page numbers them.

rows.label: Recipe photograph
rows.guidance: See the image specification. 600 by 450, 38 KB after processing. Optional, but a carousel of ten cards with no photographs is a weaker page than one with them.

rows.label: Carousel position
rows.guidance: Which order the carousel runs in. We will default to submission order if none is given.
